newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Sept crude oil, natural gas output up.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Sept crude oil, natural gas output up.

text.p: China produced 118.18 million tonnes of crude oil in the first nine months of 1996 (roughly 3.15 million barrels per day), a rise of 6.22 percent from the same period in 1995, the State Statistical Bureau said in a report issued on Thursday.
Oil production in September alone was 12.97 million tonnes (around 3.11 million bpd), it said.
Natural gas output totalled 14.781 billion cubic metres in the first nine months of the year, up 15.61 percent compared with the year-ago period, it said.
Gas production in September alone was 1.652 billion cubic metres.
